deviations.what: t25 split: the webhook's jira.issue.created merged now; the poller's created emission moves to t31 and the neutral jira.* renames to t37
deviations.reason: Codex's t25 renamed live pr-upkeep.jira.* events and dropped the synthetic creation transition, which would have stopped jira-intake and jira-comment-consumer in production. The poller half collides with pinned pr-upkeep stage/replay invariants that t31 rewrites anyway, and the renames are only safe once no graph workflow listens for the old names (t37). Owner chose this split.

deviations.what: Add task t38, engine wiring, before t32: run the declaration engine in the server, drive ExpireDue / EmitActionResults / DrainSubject / ThawAndReplay on a schedule, a switch-flip route using FreezeHook and ThawAndReplay, the t27 engine-side stamping refusal, the t10xt12 drain-on-close seam, and register the engine_declaration_engine identity
deviations.reason: No plan task owned wiring the declaration engine into a running binary. t9-t18 each built primitives and left explicit wiring obligations. t32 (shadow parity on real traffic) and t36 (live signals) cannot run without it. Owner approved.

deviations.what: Add task t38c and a code.result trigger kind: the control plane stamps human.ask and code.run (a scheduler pass binds the produced artifact to the firing's marker and emits human.decision / code.result reaction events carrying it), so must-links chain through human decisions and code steps
deviations.reason: Review findings C1/C2: no bridge stamps human.ask or code.run, nothing emits human.decision, and no code.result trigger kind existed, so lineage broke at pr-upkeep's readiness -> human-merges-pr -> finish must-links. Owner approved option 1A on 2026-09-28, including the vocabulary change.

deviations.what: Sensitivity model (t30b): GitHub's audience is per repository (a public repo ranks public, a private repo org); exposure is approved per variable through a list on the declaration ('may this declaration expose data type V'), each entry approved by the variable's owner, replacing t30's per (declaration version, source version, variable, target) approval tasks
deviations.reason: Owner decision 2026-09-28 on decision 2: most repos, like this one, are public; a per-declaration exposure list is how the owner wants to approve exposure.

deviations.what: Break-glass stop powers (t19b): a break-glass credential bound to a human may deactivate a declaration and flip the engine switch to 'before', nothing else on the declaration routes; ADR 0014 section 3's break-glass clause is narrowed to that
deviations.reason: Owner decision 2026-09-28 on decision 4, for now, revisit if needed: an emergency needs a way to stop, not to create or activate; cortex found the clause unreachable (break-glass lacks the namespace-admin role).

deviations.what: Event mapping and start nodes (t38d): adopt t38's payload convention (payload.node, payload.origin {marker, artifact_kind, artifact_id, author, bridge_account}) as recorded design; an event without a verified marker always arrives at root; a declaration may declare start_from: any, or start_from by engine-derived node type ({host: spark|thor|orin}, {actor_kind: claude|codex|qwen|human|code}), recorded on each landing node from the action that produced it
deviations.reason: Owner decision 2026-09-28 on decision 3: option A plus declarations that can start from any node or from nodes of a type; types are derived from the action, not author labels.

deviations.what: Three trigger kinds join the closed vocabulary (t31b): pr-upkeep.pr (the live sweep fact, unrenamed), agent.result (a completed agent.work run's outcome, a proposed claim never evidence; agent.work also produces agent_work), jira.issue.transitioned (the neutral reaction to jira.transition). agent.result and jira.issue.transitioned have no emitter yet; t38d adds them.
deviations.reason: t31's migrated declarations could not chain with the registered kinds: no trigger carried a completed agent run's outcome, the live pr-upkeep entry fact had no kind, and the jira transition reaction had only legacy per-status names. Owner approved 2026-09-28.
